name: Italian Game
description: A classical beginner opening focused on quick development, center control, and early king safety.

moves.explanation: White claims central space and opens lines for the bishop and queen.
Black mirrors the center fight and opens their own pieces.
The knight develops naturally and attacks the e5 pawn.
Black defends e5 while bringing a piece toward the center.
The bishop develops to an active diagonal and points at the sensitive f7 square.

ideas: Control the center with e4 and piece activity.
Develop knights and bishops before making extra pawn moves.
Castle early once the kingside pieces are out.
Look for pressure on f7, but do not rush attacks without development.
commonMistakes: Moving the queen out before minor pieces are developed.
Pushing too many pawns while pieces stay at home.
Ignoring threats against the e4 pawn.
